The current promotion bridge checks +VECTOR hook_calls and selected-layer applied_vector_sha256, then accepts wrong-layer evidence from verdict.wrong_layer_evidence_complete/wrong_layer_ok. It does not independently require wrong_layer_same_selected_vector, wrong_layer_vector_source_layer, wrong_layer_receipt_sha256, or a wrong-layer receipt family before emitting a direct steering candidate.

hypothesis: Executor-local same-vector localization provenance can be lost at the promotion boundary because the bridge trusts summary verdict booleans instead of re-admitting the newly available wrong-layer provenance fields.
counterhypothesis: Exact source/execution attestation plus the upstream protocol PASS may make tampering operationally difficult, but that does not make the bridge's evidence shape self-contained or fail-closed at its own admission boundary.
falsifier: Show an exact-current bridge path that independently verifies the wrong-layer vector source layer, same-selected-vector equality and bound wrong-layer runtime receipt family before direct-candidate emission, or show a stronger canonical downstream admission that cryptographically binds and revalidates those exact fields.

Require wrong_layer_vector_source_layer equals the frozen selected layer and wrong_layer differs from the selected intervention layer.
Require a valid wrong_layer_receipt_sha256 for every holdout case and bind the resulting receipt family into the emitted direct candidate/analysis receipt.
Add a deterministic negative regression where verdict booleans remain PASS-shaped but same-vector wrong-layer provenance is absent or mismatched; the bridge must reject it.
Do not create a second bridge or scientific lane; harden the retained bridge in place.
